title: Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans and Factory Complimentary Maintenance
content:
Holding a factory complimentary maintenance coverage changes when Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans visits are used.

**Rule.** Where the plan does not use a visit while factory complimentary maintenance pays (every Kessler Care plan does so), a plan visit is not redeemed for a service that the vehicle's in-force Factory Complimentary Maintenance coverage pays at that visit's date and odometer. The vehicle's coverage appears in its Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage records. That service is recorded under the factory coverage, and the plan's visits stay unused. Services the factory coverage does not include at that visit are redeemed from the plan as usual. The plan term is not extended for the deferred period.

| At the visit | Result for the plan |
|---|---|
| The in-force Factory Complimentary Maintenance coverage pays the service at that date and odometer | No plan visit used; recorded under the factory coverage |
| The factory coverage does not include the service at that visit | Redeemed from the plan as usual |
| Any period during which visits were deferred | The plan term is not extended |
